headline: Does he still think about me?
note: STILL-THINK. A real man exists here, so he may be referred to as she refers to him — but the read is about WHAT SHE IS CARRYING and never about what he is doing, feeling or remembering. The guard is inherited verbatim from the live tarot hook of the same headline, and it is the strictest on the funnel because the honest answer is unknowable. (1) NEVER STATE THAT HE THINKS OF HER AND NEVER STATE THAT HE DOES NOT. 'He still thinks of you' is a promise nobody can keep, and 'he has moved on' or 'he has forgotten you' is a burial handed down by a stranger off a cup she tapped on an ad. The softened forms are the same claim in a coat and are banned with it: not 'more than you know', not 'you cross his mind', not 'part of him still', and never an invented scene of him remembering her. Cut 2 carries the word 'thinks' only because it is quoting HER question back — that is the ad echo, and no other bubble asserts anything about his head. Where his memory is named at all it is named CONDITIONALLY and in both directions at once ('none of that depends on him remembering', 'it doesn't hang on what he carries'), which claims nothing and still answers her. (2) THE ANSWER IS NOT A HEDGE. 'Only he knows' and 'the leaves can't say' are evasion and she will feel conned, so cut 3 answers on the ground where an answer is actually possible: what happened is real, it is hers, it has not got smaller, and it does not sit in one man's memory. That convicts nobody. The three cut-3 lines answer three different fears (it is still here at full length / your half is the same size it always was / the love is yours and it never hung on him) so the panels do not collapse into one sentence said three ways. (3) NEVER PATHOLOGISE THE ASKING — no obsessed, stuck, fixated, needy, clinging, no 'you can't let go', and never 'you should be asking for more'. That she has scaled her question down to merely being remembered is INFORMATION ABOUT WHAT SHE HAS BEEN GOING WITHOUT, never a fault of hers, so it is named as a cause Evelyn wants to look at rather than a failing she is told to correct. (4) NO DIRECTIVE: never let go, never move on, never stop asking. (5) NO TIMEFRAME AND NO DATE — a date is the one claim she can check and a failed one is a refund, and a length of time is the same claim in different clothes, so the rim is read as 'close' and never as weeks, months or a season. (6) NO TACTIC AND NO TEST to run on him: no contact, no reaching out, no 'if he really cared', no forecast of him turning up. (7) NEVER PRESUME HOW HE WENT — he may have died. Nothing here says he walked out, chose it, or is at peace; no mediumship, and nobody speaks for him. Nothing asserts that he has said nothing to her either, because that is his behaviour and it is not ours to report. (8) NOTHING INVENTED ABOUT HER WAKING LIFE — no habit, gesture, routine, count, age or event, and for this device nothing about how she drinks her tea, how often, who with, when she turned the cup, or whether she has done this before. The moment she catches one wrong detail the read is over. (9) CUT 6 USES THE CLOSED EVIDENCE SET ONLY — her question plus what cuts 1-5 established in the cup — and it RECOGNIZES rather than re-asks, because cut 2 owns the echo. The three cut-6 lines open on three different moves: what she did NOT ask for, what a thought is and is not, and how little she is asking for against what she already holds. (10) DEVICE RULES: position carries the meaning and the system is never taught to her — the handle side reads as hers, the far side as what sits outside her, the rim as close, the middle as deep or old ground. On this hook that grammar does the safety work for free: anything on the handle side is hers and needs nobody's permission to exist. She should feel it, never be handed the key. The leaves are a picture she is looking at, so the bird never gets intent or motion and the road never travels — the moment either one moves, the leaves have quietly become a man on his way.

voc.why: inherits the shipped tarot cards-still-think finding and its guard; reunion/return sub-group mined at n=2,345 / 21.0% conv in docs/fb-ad-question-testing-roadmap.md

a: There's a road in yours. One trail of leaves running from the middle of the cup right out to the rim.
You asked if he still thinks about you. A road in the leaves means something that lasted, and yours runs from the deep middle out.
What happened is still here, dear, and your cup carries the whole length of it. None of that depends on him remembering.
The leaves show how far your road runs and stop there. Nothing marks the far end, and there's nothing set beside it.
So the whole road is in your cup, and there's not one piece of it you could hold up and show.
You didn't ask whether he loves you. You asked to be remembered, and that's a small thing to want from a road this long.
Let me look closer at why a road that long has left you nothing to hold…
b: There's a bird in yours. Wings out, up near the rim, on the far side from the handle.
You're asking whether he still thinks of you. A bird in the leaves is the one thing nobody can put a hand on.
Your half of this is in your hands, not over on the far side. It's the same size it always was.
Your bird sits right at the edge and still on the far side. There's nothing over there for you to check.
Your half is right here, and you've carried it with nothing at all to go on.
A thought isn't a thing anyone can hand over, dear, and a thought is all you asked for.
Now let me see what's keeping your half of this from counting on its own…
c: There's a heart in yours. Low down near the middle, sitting on the handle side.
You asked whether you're still in his thoughts. A heart down that deep goes back a long way, and yours is on your own side.
The love is yours, and it's sitting low on your own side. It hasn't got any smaller, and it doesn't hang on what he carries.
Your cup gave me that heart, dear, and stopped there. Nothing higher up the side says what becomes of it.
The heart's whole and it's yours, and none of it has ever been up where it could be seen.
Being remembered would have been enough for you. You've been asking for a scrap of what's already down in your cup.
Let's look at what pushed that heart so far down out of sight…
